user_saw: When a chat turn was rejected because its operator authority was inactive, the error gave no recovery instructions.
summary: The Gateway now tells users to reconnect and resend their message or ask an administrator to restore access if reconnection is denied.
reasoning: The product diff changes only the text of the existing authority errors, and the reconnect test checks that fresh authenticated requests succeed while revoked operations remain rejected. The PR reports that fresh requests already succeeded on the baseline and leaves the revocation that triggered the incident unattributed.
